# A target that cannot reset says so. This is the important half of 08.
#
# A `reset` that answers `ok` and does nothing is worse than a refusal: every record after
# it claims a clean state it does not have. Refusing is honest, and the ordering recorded
# with each command is what keeps the results interpretable anyway.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|deadc0de|call,read,report
OBS|part|deadc0de|target|console
OBS|part|deadc0de|firmware|13.520.001
OBS|part|deadc0de|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
CMD|2|reset
OBS|ack|2|reset
OBS|refused|2|not-negotiated
